method.engine: Python 3 stdlib sqlite3 (SQLite linked into the interpreter)
method.warm: repeated executions on one open connection after 5 warmups
method.cold: close connection, POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED on db/-wal/-shm, reopen, then one query
method.adjacency_label: SQLite relational/adjacency baseline; not a dedicated graph database
method.no_graph_db_claim: No Neo4j, SPARQL, or other graph/triple store was run.
method.same_corpus: Payload bytes, ObjectIds, relations, tags, snapshot names, and commit generations come from examples/bench_external_manifest.rs, which uses the same definitions as examples/bench_store.rs.
method.durability: WAL + synchronous=FULL; each churn insert/delete is its own committed transaction.
method.cold_limitation: Cold uses per-file page-cache eviction, not a device cache drop; the VM fio court performs a guest drop_caches.

losses.detail: The adjacency variant is a SQLite adjacency table, not a dedicated graph database; no Neo4j/SPARQL comparison is made.
Cold uses per-file POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED, not a device cache drop; the VM fio court performs a real guest drop_caches.
No authorization, Context Root, ambiguity, or evidence semantics are modelled; this is a physical-access baseline only.
